#working directory

```{r}
endocardium <- readRDS("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/5 hlhs cleaning/2 endocardium/hlhs_subset_cleaned_annotated.rds")
DimPlot(endocardium, reduction = "umap", group.by = "annotation")
```

```{r}
fibroblast <- readRDS("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/13 fibroblast further analysis and mapping/1 fibroblast further analysis/fibroblast_manual.rds")
DimPlot(fibroblast, group.by = "manual")
```

#nf endo to fib
```{r}
NF_endo_fib <- c('STAT3', 'EPAS1', 'STAT3', 'TP53', 'SOD2', 'TP53', 'STAT1', 'STAT3', 'CTNNB1', 'STAT3', 'MYC', 'TP53', 'THBS1')

NF_endo_fib <- unique(NF_endo_fib)
```

```{r}
#plotting on heatmap

#average across cell per condition

Idents(fibroblast) <- "condition"

signatures_avg <- AverageExpression(fibroblast, assays = "SCT",
                                           features = NF_endo_fib, return.seurat = T)
signatures_avg <- GetAssayData(signatures_avg, assay = "SCT")
signatures_avg_1 <- signatures_avg[, c("Donor", "NF", "SysHF")]

pdf("nf endo to fib tfs targets.pdf", width=20/2.54, height=20/2.54)
pheatmap(signatures_avg_1, scale = "row", cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F,
         color= plasma(100))
dev.off()
```
